name: Genting Malaysia Berhad
overview: 2026年，Genting Malaysia Berhad 完成了两家休眠子公司的自愿清算，分别为 GMM Limited 和 Genting Alderney Limited，两者均已解散并不再属于集团。此外，公司就经常性关联交易寻求股东更新及新增授权。本年度公告中未披露任何业务板块的扩张、新业务、缩减或合约签订事项。
overview_en: In 2026, Genting Malaysia Berhad completed the members' voluntary liquidation of two dormant subsidiaries, GMM Limited and Genting Alderney Limited, both of which were dissolved and ceased to be subsidiaries of the group. In addition, the company sought shareholders' mandate for renewal and new recurrent related party transactions. No expansion, new business, reduction, or contract awards for any business segment were disclosed in this year's announcements.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面完成了两家休眠子公司的自愿清算，并寻求股东对经常性关联交易的更新及新增授权。
segments.note_en: At the group level this year, the voluntary liquidation of two dormant subsidiaries was completed, and shareholders' mandate was sought for renewal and new recurrent related party transactions.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 根据澳门商业登记局2026年9月4日签发的商业登记证书，GMM Limited 的登记状态为“已注销”，自2026年9月4日起不再存续，亦不再为公司的子公司。
actions.text_en: As confirmed in the Business Registration Certificate issued by the Commercial Registry of Macau on 4 September 2026, GMM Limited's registration status was recorded as "Cancelled";

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: GMM Limited（澳门注册的间接全资休眠子公司）股东于2026年8月11日决议根据澳门商法典第315(1)(a)条解散公司，并启动成员自愿清算。
actions.text_en: The shareholders of GMM Limited, an indirect wholly-owned dormant subsidiary incorporated in Macau, resolved on 11 August 2026 to dissolve the company pursuant to Article 315(1)(a) of the Commercial Code of Macau, and commenced members' voluntary liquidation.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Genting Alderney Limited（在Alderney注册的间接全资休眠子公司）根据《1994年公司法（Alderney）》（经修订）第119(3)条于2026年5月10日（Alderney日期）解散，不再为公司的子公司。
actions.text_en: Genting Alderney Limited, an indirect wholly-owned dormant subsidiary incorporated in Alderney, was dissolved on 10 May 2026 (Alderney date) pursuant to Section 119(3) of the Companies (Alderney) Law, 1994 (as amended), and ceased to be a subsidiary of the Com…
